ev.q: This report summarizes epidemiologic data for the 1,097 reported outbreaks occurring during 2007
Among the 146 outbreaks in which no more than two persons became ill, 51% had no confirmed or suspected etiology.
The number of outbreaks reported by each state or territory during 2007 varied from 0 to 149
Among the 363 outbreaks with an unknown etiology (5,122 illnesses), 257 outbreaks (71%) with 3,904 illnesses (76%) also had an unknown food vehicle.
Outbreaks in which few persons became ill were more likely to have an unknown etiology.
The number of foodborne disease outbreaks (1,097) reported to CDC in 2007 was 8% lower than the annual average (1,193)

methods_quotes.q: Population-based rates of reported outbreaks were calculated for each state using U.S. Census estimates of the 2007 state populations.
Outbreaks in which the reported food vehicle contained ingredients from only one commodity were assigned to that commodity
If all reported etiologies were laboratory-confirmed, the outbreak was considered to have a "confirmed etiology."
